title: ServerlessPrunePlugin
description: Schema for the serverless-prune-plugin (https://github.com/claygregory/serverless-prune-plugin). Goes under `custom.prune`.

Prune.title: Prune
Prune.description: Prune-plugin configuration. Removes old versions of deployed Lambda functions (and optionally layers).

number.description: Number of versions to keep. Set to 0 to delete every version except $LATEST.

includeLayers.description: Extend pruning to Lambda layer versions using the same retention logic.
